fields.name: FAQ · How do I find the right ritual?
fields.title: How do I find the right ritual?
fields.body: Start with the collection and choose a product category. Each product page brings together its story, available options, and product information so you can explore at your own pace.

fields.name: FAQ · Where can I read the ingredient list?
fields.title: Where can I read the ingredient list?
fields.body: Read the product description and ingredient story on each product page. If you need the complete formulation or further details, contact DYU before choosing a product.

fields.name: FAQ · Can I look at products in 3D?
fields.title: Can I look at products in 3D?
fields.body: Where available, the product viewer lets you rotate a study based on the main product photograph. Unseen surfaces are approximations. The original product photos remain available in the gallery.

fields.name: FAQ · How do I place an order?
fields.title: How do I place an order?
fields.body: Select an available product option and add it to your bag. Checkout continues securely with Shopify. If an item is unavailable, contact DYU for more information.

fields.name: FAQ · What are the shipping and return options?
fields.title: What are the shipping and return options?
fields.body: Visit Shipping & returns for the information currently available, or contact DYU about your delivery location and return questions before placing an order.

fields.name: Journal · The quiet art of making time for yourself.
fields.title: The quiet art of making time for yourself.
fields.note: A small pause can change the shape of an ordinary day.
fields.body:
Some days move faster than we do. We arrive at the evening with a long list behind us and very little space left for ourselves. A ritual can be a way of finding that space again.

Start small. A quiet minute before opening your phone. A warm shower without rushing. A familiar routine that asks you to pay attention to what you are doing, rather than what comes next.

You do not need a perfect setting or an elaborate sequence. Choose a moment that already exists in your day and let it be a little slower. Notice the water, the light, the sound of the room.

A ritual is something you return to. Let yours be simple enough to repeat, and personal enough to feel like your own.
fields.image_alt: A sunlit still life of everyday care

fields.name: Journal · A little curiosity goes a long way.
fields.title: A little curiosity goes a long way.
fields.note: Getting to know the things we bring into our everyday.
fields.body:
Every product has details worth understanding. What is in it? How should it be used? Where can you find the full ingredient list?

Take a moment to read a product’s directions and ingredient information. A pleasing texture or beautiful package is only one part of the story.

When you have a question, ask it. Thoughtful care starts with clear information and the room to make your own decision.
